name: Tapline
description: Hosted Tapline MCP server that gives AI agents live, structured JSON from public web pages: YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, X, LinkedIn, Facebook, Pinterest, Airbnb, Zillow, Expedia, Google Maps, Brave Search and Indeed. Four read-only tools: search_endpoints, get_endpoint, call_endpoint and read_more. New accounts get 100 free credits; failed requests are not charged. OAuth 2.1 sign-in with a Tapline account.
author: Tapline
